text_block_list.text:
The first of the Classic Triple Crown
battles, the
Satsuki Sho, is upon us. The
hype for this race is
on a different level
from any other so far.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Some fans consider Эйсин Флэш a cut
below her
competitors... but her
approach remains
unchanged.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's business as usual for her as she
makes for the
track with her gaze fixed
straight ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
